{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The Jessar creation myth tells us that with the naming of things, they came into being, and the Jessar were charged with never violating the creative power of the word.|[[Rokari Kem]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
The '''Jessar creation myth''' was a legend of the [[Jessar]] [[Species/Legends|race]] which claimed that all things came into being when they were initially named. As a result, the Jessar refrained from violation of the creative power of words in any way, shape or form.
